title: 指甲鉗
subject: cutting your eighty-year-old mother's toenails on a low stool
caption: Cantonese neo-soul funk cut with a live band. Clavinet playing a syncopated comp through a light phaser, a three-piece horn section answering the vocal and sitting slightly behind the beat, fat round electric bass carrying the groove, drum kit played loose with the hi-hat half open, Rhodes pads underneath. Warm analogue mix with tape saturation, horns a touch dark, nothing bright. Warm male voice, low and relaxed, conversational with a little gospel-adjacent grit on line ends. 92 BPM, E flat major. Intimate and slightly awed. No four-on-the-floor, no synth lead, no rap, no big belted climax, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
阿媽坐低 腳放喺膠盆度
佢話「我自己剪得嘅」 剪咗三次都剪唔到
我拎張矮凳 坐低 坐到低過佢
第一次 我望上去同佢講話

[Pre-Chorus]
指甲好硬 比我想像硬好多
佢個腳跟 一層一層 咁多年

[Chorus]
指甲鉗 剪一下 停一下
我唔敢快 我怕夾到佢
佢喺度講隔籬屋嗰個仔結婚
我冇答 我嗯一聲 一隻腳趾 嗯一聲

[Verse]
剪完佢話「唔用咁好手勢嘅」
然後佢自己望住自己隻腳 望咗好久
佢話「原來咁靚嘅」
佢對腳八十年 第一次有人話靚

[Chorus]
指甲鉗 剪一下 停一下
我唔敢快 我怕夾到佢
佢喺度講隔籬屋嗰個女搬走咗
我冇答 我嗯一聲 一隻腳趾 嗯一聲

[Outro]
膠盆嘅水 我倒咗
指甲鉗 我放返抽屜 原本位置
